description_en: Creates or updates a lane group for an end-to-end canary release
description_zh: 用于创建或者更新全链路灰度泳道组
name: CreateOrUpdateSwimmingLaneGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the MSE namespace
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lane group. If you set this parameter to -1, a lane group is created. If you set this parameter to a value greater than 0, the specified lane group is modified
parameters.help_zh: 泳道组ID。-1时为创建泳道组，大于0时为修改指定泳道组
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the lane group
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the lane group is enabled. A value of 0 indicates that the lane group is disabled. A value of 1 indicates that the lane group is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 取值为0表示未生效，取值为1表示生效
parameters.name: status
entry_app

parameters.help_en: The IDs of applications. Separate multiple application IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 应用集合。以 "," 分割应用 id
parameters.name: app_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable canary release for messages
parameters.name: message_queue_gray_enable

parameters.help_en: The side for message filtering in a canary release
parameters.name: message_queue_filter_side

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Specifies whether to enable canary release for databases
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，是否开启数据库灰度
parameters.name: db_gray_enable

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to record the details of canary release requests
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启记录请求详情
parameters.name: record_canary_detail

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. This parameter is used when a Java gateway is the entry application
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，java网关为入口时填写该参数
parameters.name: paths

parameters.help_en: The list of route IDs. If a cloud-native gateway is used as the entry application, you must call this operation to pass the list of route IDs for the cloud-native gateway before you create a lane for the lane group
parameters.help_zh: 路由ID列表（以云原生网关为入口时，在创建泳道组的泳道前，需调用本接口传入选择的云原生网关路由ID列表）
parameters.name: route_ids

parameters.help_en:
The canary release mode.

0: Content-based routing

1: Proportional routing
parameters.help_zh:
全链路灰度模式：

0: 按请求内容路由

1: 按比例路由
parameters.name: canary_model

parameters.help_en: The version of the end-to-end canary release. Valid values: 0 and 2. A value of 0 is not recommended because you must specify a route. A value of 2 is recommended because you do not need to specify a route
parameters.help_zh: 全链路灰度版本，取值范围：0（不推荐使用，需要指定路由）,2(推荐使用，无需指定路由)
parameters.name: swim_version

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
